title: WHAT IF EVERYONE COULD READ YOUR MIND? 🧠😱 #Shorts
description:
What if everyone could hear your unfiltered thoughts out loud? When Pip stepped into a coffee shop, he casually thought about the barista's terrible haircut... and she immediately threw hot coffee at him! ☕💥

If your best friend could hear every thought in your head for just ONE HOUR... would you still be friends? 👇

🔔 Subscribe to WHAT-EIF before your thoughts leak out!
